purpose: Named-zone protected payload for a live schedule.placement MaterialState.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_placement_named_zone_state
primary_key.reason: At most one named-zone payload per placement state.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_placement_named_zone_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind payload to the authoritative placement envelope.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_placement_named_zone_state_interval_order
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(starts_local_at) AND ((extent_code IN ('point','start_only') AND ends_local_at IS NULL) OR (extent_code='interval' AND ends_local_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(ends_local_at) AND ends_local_at > starts_local_at))
check_constraints.reason: Require finite ordered named-zone local boundaries.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_placement_named_zone_state_resolved_pair
check_constraints.expression_contract: (resolved_start_at IS NULL OR isfinite(resolved_start_at)) AND (resolved_end_at IS NULL OR (resolved_start_at IS NOT NULL AND extent_code='interval' AND isfinite(resolved_end_at) AND resolved_end_at > resolved_start_at))
check_constraints.reason: Keep optional resolved instants finite and ordered.

triggers.name: trg_schedule_placement_named_zone_state_iana_timezone
triggers.reason: Database-local enforcement for IANA timezone validity and round-trip resolution.

triggers.name: ctrg_schedule_placement_named_zone_state_placement_payload
triggers.reason: Requires exactly one matching live placement payload, or no payload after explicit retirement.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Protected schedule.placement payload; envelope/address survive its retirement.
state_history.chronology: Current/history chronology remains outside this payload row.
state_history.immutability_policy: No ordinary runtime table-level UPDATE surface.

lifecycle.retention: Retain only while the MaterialState remains live or policy requires the protected payload.
lifecycle.redaction: Delete this payload in the canonical retirement transaction before material_state_retirement commits.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: dante.material_state_retirement preserves the MaterialStateRef and explicit reason/time after payload removal.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime has no DELETE; owner/recovery lifecycle path removes payload only as part of validated retirement/reconciliation.
